newsitem.title: USA: Consumers says seeks alternate acquirer.
newsitem.headline: Consumers says seeks alternate acquirer.

text.p: Consumers Financial Corp said Friday it would renew its search for an alternate acquiror.

The company said the decision is a result of LaSalle Group Inc's May 15 disclosure that it is unlikely that LaSalle's original source of funding would be available by June 15, 1997 and that it is in the process of securing alternative funding.
Consumers Financial said the merger agreement with LaSalle was approved by Consumers' common stockholders on March 25, 1997 and extended by letter agreements on March 31 and May 1, 1997.

Under the terms of the amended agreement, Consumers Financial said LaSalle was required to provide cash funds or satisfactory evidence of such funds in order to consummate the merger under the terms of the agreement on or before May 15, 1997.

If LaSalle failed to meet this requirement, Consumers had the right to renew its search for alternative acquirors and either party was then entitled to terminate the transaction on or after June 15, Consumers Financial said.
